about: Operator-selected contract profile for docviz's own extension: the accounting promise in CLAUDE.md and SPEC.md's Cost section. Passed explicitly with --contracts; never read from a reviewed checkout.

contracts.title: Every paid helper call stays attributed
contracts.condition: A helper call reports usage, so it spent money
contracts.expectation: The spend ledger records it, and a card's cost breakdown or the page's unassigned total carries it
contracts.violation: The ledger grows while no card and no page total shows that spend
